name: boohoo
known_for: Online Fashion for Women and Men
notes: Dresses page (us.boohoo.com/womens/dresses): live women's dresses category; product grid loads client-side, so no prices rendered (no price row). Banners: 'SPOOKY DISCOUNT - UP TO 20% OFF', '70% OFF ALMOST EVERYTHING*', 'Discounts may not be based on former prices'.
Delivery: 'USA Standard Shipping' $10.99, 6–8 business days; table lists USA and Canada; 'NO EXTRA TARIFF CHARGES. WE GOT OUR STATESIDE BABES!'
Returns: 21 days from receipt; '$14.99 per parcel' deducted from the refund; store credit pays a 20% bonus.
Size guide: US 0–26 main chart; petite range for 5ft 3in; plus and tall columns in length guides.

Wikipedia (Boohoo_Group infobox): founded 2006 by Mahmud Kamani and Carol Kane; HQ Dale Street, Manchester; brands include boohoo, PrettyLittleThing, Karen Millen, Debenhams; trading as Debenhams Group since March 2025, legal name still Boohoo Group.
known_for from the store's own title: 'boohoo | Womens and Mens Clothes | Shop Online Fashion'.
